title: Pointer Events, touch-action, and setPointerCapture
description: Trace compositor touch-action negotiation, pointer capture, and pointercancel prevention.

steps.label: 1. Compositor Reads touch-action
steps.description: Before JS runs, compositor checks touch-action: pan-y on the slider track (horizontal drag owned by JS).

steps.label: 2. Capture Pointer on pointerdown
steps.description: Handler calls thumb.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId) so fast drags outside the thumb still deliver events.

steps.label: 3. Continuous pointermove & Release
steps.description: pointermove streams without pointercancel; pointerup automatically releases capture.
